purpose: Four unique reader illustrations and one separate collection-card illustration for Devi and Shumbha–Nishumbha

assets.brief: Unique symbolic collection card: a lion, bell and red banner on an imagined Himalayan ridge as seven lights converge into one.
Chandika with her lion on a luminous Himalayan peak; surrounding feminine presences suggest the divine energies without claiming an exhaustive iconographic chart.
Non-graphic devotional interpretation of fierce Kali / Chamunda advancing while the army of Chanda and Munda recoils; Ambika and her lion remain visible.
Chandika, Chamunda and the divine feminine energies confront stylised multiplying forms of Raktabija; crimson droplets are symbolic and non-graphic.
Non-graphic airborne final contest between Chandika and Shumbha above an imagined Himalayan landscape as storm clouds clear.

conversion: Sharp WebP quality 88, effort 5; 1536 × 1024 output assets
